description: Find the account that shared an Instagram link, from a link copied with the Share button in the app. A link from a browser's address bar can't be traced. Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

include_raw.description: Return everything each source sent instead of the main fields. Much longer; off by default.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

url.description: The share link, as copied from the Instagram app.

name: instagram_share_trace
title: Instagram share link trace
